fieldDescription: Colour of the regeneration bar. Transparency is not part of this picker and stays at the value in data/config/ammo_regen_bar.json.
Thickness as a fraction of the ammo bar's short side. The ammo bar is only about 20 by 9 pixels, so a vertical bar usually wants a smaller value than a horizontal one.
Where the bar sits across the ammo bar. Has no effect while the vertical bar is switched on.
Draw the bar along the ammo bar instead of across it. It fills upwards, and is short: expect about nine visible steps.
Which side of the ammo bar a vertical bar sits on. Has no effect while the vertical bar is switched off.
